findings.text: Cost tracking centers on a record named lru_cost that stores a count plus rotation and input markers. The reclaim vessel named lruvec aggregates list heads plus a reclaim lock named lru_lock and cost entries guarded by a distinct lock named cost_lock, alongside age and refault state and flag words and optional generation and node linkage and swap backing state.

The lock named lru_lock guards list membership, while the lock named cost_lock guards balance data. Balance maintenance during scan preparation serializes on the cost lock independently from list mutation.

The helper named lru_gen_init_pgdat does nothing, and the helper named lru_gen_init_lruvec also does nothing, and similarly the helpers for control group setup and exit and online and offline and release and soft reclaim and maximum tracking leave state unchanged, as does reparenting.
The probe named lru_gen_look_around yields false without inspecting memory, while the check named recheck_lru_gen_max_memcg yields true without further validation.

The type named isolate_mode_t is a bitwise unsigned value. The flag named ISOLATE_ASYNC_MIGRATE carries value 0x4 [CITED], while the flag named ISOLATE_UNEVICTABLE carries value 0x8 [CITED], giving distinct combinable bits.

The enumeration named zone_watermarks starts with a member named WMARK_MIN, followed by a member named WMARK_LOW, then a member named WMARK_HIGH, then a member named WMARK_PROMO, closing with a sentinel named NR_WMARK that counts the levels.

The constant named NR_LOWORDER_PCP_LISTS scales with the migrate kind count named MIGRATE_PCPTYPES multiplied by the costly order named PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER plus 1 [CITED]. The total named NR_PCP_LISTS adds the huge-page allowance named NR_PCP_THP, which holds 2 [CITED] when enabled and 0 [CITED] when disabled.

The structure named per_cpu_pages carries occupancy and threshold and batch fields plus flag storage and scaling and expiry and free tally alongside a list array. A flag named PCPF_PREV_FREE_HIGH_ORDER uses the lowest bit to mark prior high-order freeing, while another flag named PCPF_FREE_HIGH_BATCH uses the next bit to mark high batch freeing.
The spin lock inside the structure named per_cpu_pages protects the list array and the flag byte, so queue edits and flag changes are mutually exclusive.

The structure named per_cpu_zonestat holds zone deltas and a fold threshold plus optional NUMA event tallies, while the structure named per_cpu_nodestat holds a threshold and node deltas, using narrow signed deltas for frequent updates and wider storage for infrequent NUMA folding.

The enumeration named zone_type begins with an optional member named ZONE_DMA, plus an optional member named ZONE_DMA32 [CITED] for wider DMA limits, then a member named ZONE_NORMAL for directly addressable memory, plus an optional member named ZONE_HIGHMEM for indirectly mapped memory, then a member named ZONE_MOVABLE for relocatable pages, plus an optional member named ZONE_DEVICE for device memory, ending with a sentinel named __MAX_NR_ZONES marking the count.

The zone named ZONE_MOVABLE must not accumulate unmovable allocations, or offlining and large-page efforts suffer. Pinning and boot reserves and holes and poison and offline balloon parts and the zero [CITED] page and self-stored hotplug maps each create exceptions that resist movement or allocation, and migration there can fail despite a clean scan, so callers must handle failure.
The structure named zone keeps watermark storage plus boost and reserves and node linkage and per-CPU sets and span counts and identity fields on its read side.

The field named spanned_pages covers the full extent including holes, the field named present_pages excludes holes, and the field named managed_pages further excludes boot reservations, with CMA pages tracked as a subset. Unmanaged memory appears as presence beyond managed, while managed drives watermark and scanner math.

The sequence lock named span_seqlock guards the start and span pair against concurrent extension, the spin lock named lock guards free areas and isolate accounting, and hotplug pairing guards presence updates with a stable-read guard for sensitive readers.

The structure named zone places free areas and optional unaccepted memory handling and flags and deferred-free queuing and drift and compaction tracking and contiguity and statistics in write-intensive cache-separated regions.

The set named pgdat_flags uses a member named PGDAT_WRITEBACK for writeback-heavy scans and a member named PGDAT_RECLAIM_LOCKED to exclude concurrent reclaim. The set named zone_flags combines a member named ZONE_BOOSTED_WATERMARK plus a member named ZONE_RECLAIM_ACTIVE plus a member named ZONE_BELOW_HIGH for boost and scan and level state.

The helper named wmark_pages adds boost to the stored base, with dedicated helpers for minimum and low and high and promo thresholds. Managed counts use atomic reads, CMA counts vanish without support, end arithmetic and half-open span tests define membership, and emptiness and readiness reflect span and initialization.

The offset named SECTIONS_PGOFF anchors the top of the packing, with successive offsets for node and zone and CPU and tag and generation and reference derived by subtracting widths. Companion shifts mirror those offsets while collapsing absent fields to a neutral shift, keeping extraction stable.

The width named ZONEID_SHIFT joins section or node width with zone width per build, with its offset chosen as the lower participant and its shift neutralized when empty. Each mask named for its field selects the low range implied by that field width for later shifting and masking.

The helper named memdesc_zonenum isolates the zone bits from descriptor flags with an exclusivity check, while companions named page_zonenum and folio_zonenum delegate to it for their respective owners.

The predicate named is_zone_device_page and the folio twin named folio_is_zone_device detect device backing, while the predicate named is_zone_movable_page and the folio twin named folio_is_zone_movable detect movable placement, with map lookup and same-map logic collapsing to constants when device support is absent.
The test named zone_intersects returns negative for empty zones and for disjoint ranges outside the half-open zone extent, returning affirmative only on true overlap.

The constant named DEF_PRIORITY holds 12 [CITED]. The capacity named MAX_ZONES_PER_ZONELIST multiplies node count by zone count, and the list kinds separate a member named ZONELIST_FALLBACK with fallback from a member named ZONELIST_NOFALLBACK without fallback on NUMA builds, ending with a count sentinel.

The entry named zoneref couples a zone pointer with its index, while the list named zonelist stores a terminated array with 1 [CITED] spare slot beyond capacity. The record for memory failure keeps a total plus outcome buckets that partition the total and correspond to corrupted capacity.
The constant named ASYNC_AND_SYNC holds 2 [CITED] to size per-mode compaction cursor storage for asynchronous versus synchronous passes.
